title: Extension Committee Standard: Prior Listing-Backed Grant on a Further Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**The earlier grant.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the extension already granted on the case is the most recently granted extension. The request behind it is the accepted extension request received most recently. Among accepted requests received on the same day, it is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time.

**Rule.**

- Where that request rested on a listing agreement and the extension was granted more than 60 calendar days before this grant, 14 calendar days are taken off the extension length, the property having been marketed that long without a sale.
- Where that request rested on a listing agreement and the extension was granted no more than 60 calendar days before this grant, 7 calendar days are taken off it.
- Where that request rested on a financing commitment or a document of another kind, or no granted extension is on record on the case, nothing is taken off.

| Document behind the earlier accepted request | Days since the most recent grant | Days taken off the extension length |
|---|---|---|
| listing agreement | more than 60 | 14 |
| listing agreement | 60 or fewer | 7 |
| financing commitment, or another kind | any | 0 |
| no granted extension on record | not applicable | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical; this grant on 30 November)

- An earlier listing-backed grant on 1 October was 60 days before: 7 days are taken off.
- An earlier listing-backed grant on 30 September was 61 days before: 14 days are taken off.
